subject.title: feat(skills): capture reusable techniques from successful work

question: Should the existing persisted `skills.workshop.autonomous.enabled` opt-in also authorize delayed successful-turn transcript review and an additional model run after upgrade?
rationale: This expands an existing setting's cost and privacy semantics; implementation correctness cannot determine whether previous consent to correction capture covers the new background review behavior.

options.title: Expand the existing opt-in
options.body: Treat the existing autonomy setting as consent for both correction capture and successful-work review, with prominent documentation and Control UI disclosure.

options.title: Require separate consent
options.body: Add a distinct successful-work review setting so existing autonomous-capture users retain their previous behavior after upgrading.

options.title: Defer successful-work review
options.body: Keep deterministic correction capture only until maintainers settle the consent and discoverability design.

recommendation.title: Expand the existing opt-in
recommendation.body: Treat the existing autonomy setting as consent for both correction capture and successful-work review, with prominent documentation and Control UI disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Skill Workshop owner has the strongest history for evaluating whether this expands or violates the established autonomy contract.
